## Problem
<!-- What can't you do today? Who is blocked — a user, an operator, an evaluator? -->

## Proposed solution
<!-- What would you build, and roughly how would it work? -->

## Surface & scope
- [ ] User product
- [ ] Operator console / incident sync
- [ ] Observability
- [ ] Tooling / CI / docs

## Alignment with project principles
<!-- AIRA-X holds firm invariants. Please confirm the request respects them: -->
- [ ] Keeps **local state as the source of truth** (external systems never authoritative)
- [ ] Keeps recovery **explicit and audited** (no auto-remediation)
- [ ] Preserves **operator/user separation**
- [ ] Stays **deterministic and explainable** (no opaque/AI-driven operational advice)
- [ ] Is **additive** (no breaking API/DB/UX changes)

## Alternatives considered
<!-- What else did you weigh, and why is this better? -->

## Out of scope?
<!-- AIRA-X is feature-complete for portfolio/commercial demonstration. New adapters,
     speculative AI features, and auto-remediation are intentionally out of scope —
     see CONTRIBUTING.md. Explain why this is an exception if it touches those. -->
